prompt: We operate three sites but only want to certify one of them. Which ISO 14001 clause requires us to define the boundaries and applicability of our EMS?
response:
The clause you're looking for is **Clause 4.3: Determining the scope of the environmental management system**.

This clause explicitly requires your organization to:

- **Determine the boundaries** of the EMS (which can include facilities, activities, products, and services)
- **Determine the applicability** of the EMS requirements to the scope
- **Document the scope** as documented information

When certifying only one of your three sites, you'll need to clearly define in your scope statement which site is included, what activities/processes at that site are covered, and any applicable exclusions. The scope must also consider:
- External and internal issues (Clause 4.1)
- Compliance obligations (Clause 4.2)
- The organization's unit, function, and physical boundaries
- Its activities, products, and services

Your certification body will verify that your scope is appropriate and that activities at your other two sites don't create environmental aspects/impacts that should reasonably be included.
